handoff.objective: Review the source-TT compiler cost model and derive implementation-freeze requirements.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether every direct sum, streamed product matrix, transfer, factorization, recompression, retained core, target specialization, traffic term, and peak state is chargeable under a feasible B=3,4,5 schedule.
constraints: Separate field operations, logical traffic, canonical storage, Python RSS, and wall time.
Do not compare verifier-only B^5 work as if it were producer preprocessing.
Require exact implementation-derived ceilings before approval.
deliverables: cost equations and missing charge terms
recommended hard ceilings and stopping tests
completion_gate: Every local matrix, transfer, factorization copy, direct sum, retained core, and target specialization has a charge rule.
Cumulative traffic and peak live state are distinct.
The comparator boundary cannot be read as a sub-rho claim.
handoff.return_format: Use the repository handoff headings and end with one next concrete action.
